rationale: OctoMed emitted valid RadLE JSON but on two cases phrased a genuine decline-to-commit as 'None of the above' / 'None' (likert null) instead of the canonical 'I don't know'. The model's OWN reasoning explicitly declines in both cases, so these are abstentions, not diagnoses and not repairable failures (re-inference would not help and would break parity). The radiologist ruled both as abstentions. Diagnosis is normalized to 'I don't know' with likert null; the RadLE prompt and image payload were unchanged and no re-inference was done. This recovers the model's own intent from its own text; it does not add information. Separately, 26 cases where OctoMed wrote 'I don't know' with a curly apostrophe (U+2019) are canonicalized to the straight-quote spelling by a generic is_abstention_variant rule in apply_octomed_cleanup.py (glyph normalization, not a per-case judgment), so they are not listed here.
